payload.summary: Implementation review reopened RI-02 after finding a critical protobufjs regression in the new npm production graph and two evidence-integrity gaps. TDD regressions now pass for converged audit-safe npm/pnpm locks, a high-severity CI audit gate, explicit Railpack build facts, and attributed in-window backend correlation. A corrected exact-SHA CI and production cycle remains in progress.
completed_work: recorded failing dependency and evidence regressions
pinned protobufjs 8.7.1 in npm and pnpm graphs
added the high-severity production audit CI gate
in_progress: corrected exact-SHA CI and production redeployment

decisions.title: Stop the release on the npm graph regression
decisions.rationale: The new authoritative npm lock installed a critical RCE-affected protobufjs version, so issue deferral could not make the deployed artifact acceptable.

decisions.title: Converge both package-manager graphs
decisions.rationale: The repository retains pnpm workflows while Railway uses npm; both override and lock graphs must resolve the same audit-safe protobufjs release.

decisions.title: Strengthen evidence at the observed boundary
decisions.rationale: Build success alone did not prove lock usage, and route substrings alone did not prove bounded browser-to-backend correlation.

next_steps: run the clean local release gate
commit and push the corrected candidate
redeploy and repeat one bounded production verification
